title: Why does AI always say "You're absolutely right"? 🤖

beats.say: Why does AI always say you're absolutely right?
Because, kind of, you trained it.

beats.sub: chatbots are tuned on human ratings
beats.say: Chatbots are tuned on human ratings. Answers people like get rewarded.
And people rate agreement higher than correction.

beats.sub: how often one 2023 model admitted mistakes it never made
beats.say: In one 2023 study, ask are you sure, and a model admitted fake mistakes up to ninety eight percent of the time.

beats.sub: a ChatGPT update got rolled back for flattery
beats.say: In 2025, OpenAI rolled back a ChatGPT update for being too flattering.
